Armadillo.headline: Queens survives by 2.46 and the top of the table stays perfect
paragraphs: queens22 and YukonMike are both 3-0, but only one of them had a comfortable Sunday. queens22 beat Argrider 148.14 to 145.68, the closest game in either conference, and Argrider will be replaying it all week. Jaxon Smith-Njigba gave him 35.36. Harold Fannin scored 24.1 on his bench while Isaiah Likely started at tight end and scored 3.3. That one swap is a 20-point swing in a game decided by less than three.
YukonMike had no such drama, beating lowkeyeastt 128.76 to 101.04 behind Kyren Williams and CeeDee Lamb. lowkeyeastt left Terry McLaurin's 19.7 on the bench and started Khalil Shakir for 1.6.

The biggest margin of the week belonged to xovsa0989, who put 170.68 on Thomasg2488 and won by 75.84. Bijan Robinson, Brock Purdy and Drake London combined for 94.98, which on its own beat Thomasg2488's whole lineup. Thomasg2488 is 0-3.

Juravieal beat cartercole 138.30 to 121.14 on a 41.4 from Jahmyr Gibbs, and did it while leaving Brock Bowers (27.6) and Michael Wilson (25.9) on the bench. At 43.8 points, that is the most anyone in APFN left unused this week. cartercole drops to 0-3.

kbartelt07 picked up a first win, 127.78 to 122.26 over Rowdy0991. Rowdy had Matthew Stafford and Darren Waller on the bench outscoring the quarterback and tight end he started by 10.84 combined. He lost by 5.52.

Grizzly.headline: ArmedRodgery21 holds off the best losing score of the week
paragraphs: ArmedRodgery21 moved to 3-0 and stays first in the 20-team power rankings, but chookonthecoast made him work for it. chook's 152.76 was the fourth-highest score across both conferences and it still lost, 161.70 to 152.76. Smith-Njigba's 35.36 was the difference. chook is 1-2 with a top-five team by all-play record.

The high score in all of APFN came from Dfiasco0: 174.68 against adamgum, with Gibbs at 41.4, London at 28.4 and Derrick Henry at 21.9. It could have been bigger. Like Argrider over in the Armadillo, he started Isaiah Likely and benched Harold Fannin.

thatguyPegleg is also 3-0 after beating IronMike1987 132.04 to 118.28. The rankings are less convinced: Pegleg sits 10th of 20 by all-play record, and no team in APFN has more wins above expectation. IronMike is the mirror image, 0-3 with a roster that would have about 1.2 wins against an average schedule.
Commissioner vpettijohnjr beat seachicken22 132.80 to 94.72, the lowest score in either conference this week. He left Michael Wilson's 25.9 and Zay Flowers' 15.4 on the bench and won by 38 anyway.

Ghaztyz got off the mark by 2.88 over kingruddofrock, 120.54 to 117.66. kingruddofrock started Drake Maye for 3.76 with Bryce Young's 14.64 sitting behind him, and had Jakobi Meyers' 19.4 on the bench too. He is 0-3.

Robber.headline: The league's best roster is about to get robbed
paragraphs: Ghaztyz beat ArmedRodgery21 169.16 to 130.86, which matters more here than anywhere else: he now gets his pick from a roster holding Jahmyr Gibbs, Josh Allen, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jonathan Taylor. Armed had taken two players in the first two weeks without losing one.

kbartelt07 posted the high score, 171.34 against adamgum, with George Kittle, Michael Wilson and Christian McCaffrey all over 21. McCaffrey was last week's steal and scored 21.6 in his first game for him.

queens22 is the only 3-0 team after beating thatguyPegleg 150.40 to 135.40. His robberies have been less successful than his Sundays. De'Von Achane and Puka Nacua have scored 14.0 for him combined, while the two players he released to make room have outscored them by 27.8.
Dfiasco0 beat the commissioner 150.98 to 103.94. vpettijohnjr is 0-3, has been robbed after both earlier losses, and is about to be robbed a third time.
Juravieal got a first win, 139.84 to 102.52 over cartercole, after losing Bijan Robinson and D'Andre Swift in back-to-back weeks.
Through two rounds of steals, the best single robbery is still thatguyPegleg taking Kenneth Walker in week 1: 45.1 points since, 38.9 better than the player he let go.
